title: Countable Lipschitz localization of a C¹ map on an open set (parent step 1(a)–(b))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Z ⊆ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) be open and let F : ℝ^P → ℝ^n (= Euclid n) be C¹ on Z (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F Z). Then there are open sets V_l ⊆ Z, Borel sets Z_l ⊆ V_l and maps G_l : ℝ^P → ℝ^n (l ∈ ℕ) such that the Z_l are pairwise disjoint, ⋃_l Z_l = Z, every G_l is Lipschitz (LipschitzWith K_l G_l for some K_l ∈ ℝ≥0), and F = G_l on V_l for every l.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid P)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid n), IsOpen Z → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F Z → ∃ (V Zs : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (G : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid n), (∀ l, IsOpen (V l)) ∧ (∀ l, V l ⊆ Z) ∧ (∀ l, MeasurableSet (Zs l)) ∧ (∀ l, Zs l ⊆ V l) ∧ Pairwise (fun l l' => Disjoint (Zs l) (Zs l')) ∧ (⋃ l, Zs l) = Z ∧ (∀ l, ∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (G l)) ∧ ∀ l, EqOn F (G l) (V l)
